title: Hole-Sorted Component Strip
written_solution: Extract the disconnected nonzero components, sort them by hole count ascending and then by area ascending, crop each one tightly, and place the cropped components left to right with one zero column between them.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (components-all)
      (define visited (make-hash))
      (define comps (list))
      (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
        (when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0))
                   (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
          (define color (at g r c))
          (define queue (list (list r c)))
          (define cells (list))
          (hash-set! visited (cons r c) #t)
          (define (bfs)
            (unless (empty? queue)
              (define p (first queue))
              (set! queue (rest queue))
              (set! cells (cons p cells))
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (define nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
                (define nc (+ (second p) (second d)))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 0))
                           (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! visited (cons nr nc) #t)
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc))))))
              (bfs)))
          (bfs)
          (set! comps (cons (list color (reverse cells)) comps))))
      (reverse comps))
    (define (hole-count cells)
      (if (empty? cells)
          0
          (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                 (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
                 (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
                 (solid (make-hash))
                 (visited (make-hash))
                 (holes 0))
            (for ([p (in-list cells)])
              (hash-set! solid (cons (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb))) #t))
            (for* ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)])
              (when (and (not (hash-has-key? solid (cons r c)))
                         (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
                (let ((queue (list (list r c)))
                      (touch (or (= r 0) (= c 0) (= r (- h 1)) (= c (- w 1)))))
                  (hash-set! visited (cons r c) #t)
                  (define (bfs0)
                    (unless (empty? queue)
                      (define p (first queue))
                      (set! queue (rest queue))
                      (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                        (define nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
                        (define nc (+ (second p) (second d)))
                        (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                   (not (hash-has-key? solid (cons nr nc)))
                                   (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons nr nc))))
                          (when (or (= nr 0) (= nc 0) (= nr (- h 1)) (= nc (- w 1)))
                            (set! touch #t))
                          (hash-set! visited (cons nr nc) #t)
                          (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc))))))
                      (bfs0)))
                  (bfs0)
                  (when (not touch) (set! holes (+ holes 1))))))
            holes)))
    (define items
      (sort (map (lambda (item)
                   (let* ((color (first item))
                          (cells (second item))
                          (bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
                     (list (hole-count cells)
                           (length cells)
                           color
                           (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))
                 (components-all))
            (lambda (a b)
              (cond [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
                    [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b))]
                    [else (< (third a) (third b))]))))
    (define crops (map fourth items))
    (define out-h (apply max (map rows crops)))
    (define out-w (+ (apply + (map cols crops)) (max 0 (- (length crops) 1))))
    (let pack ([remaining crops] [left 0] [out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((crop (first remaining))
                 (next (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                   ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                                    [c (in-range (cols crop))])
                         (let ((v (at crop r c)))
                           (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc r (+ left c) v) acc)))))
            (pack (rest remaining) (+ left (cols crop) 1) next))))))
